basics.name: Benjamin Saul McCulloch
basics.label: Senior DevSecOps & Site Reliability Engineer · Cloud Security Lead
basics.summary: Senior DevSecOps, SRE and cloud security engineer with 15+ years of experience making Azure, AWS and GCP platforms secure, reliable and cheaper to run. Cut mean time to recovery by 65% and mean time to remediation by 70% on an enterprise tax platform processing millions of calculations a day, reduced cloud spend by 30%, cut release cycles from 30 days to 10, and led incident response that evicted active attackers.

work.name: Salvo Software
work.position: Lead of Cyber Security, Technical Accounts & DevOps
work.summary: Teams in Mexico, the USA and India were building code locally, with security spread across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Azure, AWS and GCP. Joined to own DevOps and security; promoted within months.
highlights: Built Azure Pipelines CI/CD and delivery dashboards for all three development teams, cutting the time between versions from 30 days to 10 (3x faster).
Lead the AI program: a bubblewrap-isolated ESXi/Debian sandbox for 50 developers, local models on an NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72, a fully logged AI backend and the company AI security framework.
Wrote a tool that scans every build for CVEs and alerts the owning dev team, catching vulnerabilities before release.
Built Python VIN data pipelines on a self-service Linux server: about 1,000 VINs an hour and 100,000+ collected to test diagnostic hardware.
Rolled out Intune, Defender, Conditional Access, Workspace SSO, FIDO2 MFA, 1Password and phishing simulations; handle every security incident.
Replaced paid SaaS with self-hosted Docker, Proxmox and TypeScript tools; Terraform and Ansible across three clouds; UniFi networks with WireGuard and Tailscale.

work.name: Affila Technology
work.summary: Assessments, remediation and security roadmaps for about five clients across Azure, AWS, GCP and on-prem.
highlights: Fixed every misconfiguration in MSP client UIDN's Microsoft 365 environment.
Tested a client AI chatbot (Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, PyRIT, OWASP LLM Top 10) and drove remediation of data-leak issues.
Penetration tests with Burp Suite, OWASP ZAP, Nmap, Metasploit and Kali; scans with Nessus, Qualys and Defender for Cloud mapped to NIST CSF and CIS.

work.name: UST · Client: Wolters Kluwer SureTax
work.summary: Cloud tax engine processing millions of calculations a day; SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliant.
highlights: Cut mean time to recovery by 65% by stabilizing the Azure network and adding redundancy, backed by SLOs, Datadog, Grafana and PagerDuty.
Traced recurring East US slowdowns to Patch Tuesday maintenance causing Elasticsearch timeouts and built timeout compensation with the team.
Reduced Azure costs by 30%, then a further 25%, by removing unused resources, moving to on-demand environments and right-sizing AKS.
Automated failover across Azure SQL and Cosmos DB behind Front Door, validated with Azure Chaos Studio; blue-green releases every two weeks.
Mentored about 15 engineers on SRE, secure coding and incident response.

work.name: UST · Client: Wolters Kluwer SureTax
highlights: Cut mean time to remediation by 70% with zero-downtime patching, runbooks and automated remediation.
Added SonarQube, DAST, container, secret and dependency scanning as pipeline gates; automated SOC 2 and ISO 27001 checks with Terraform, Azure Policy and Key Vault.

work.name: Avertium
work.summary: Secured Microsoft cloud and hybrid environments for 13 managed security clients against CIS, Essential Eight, NIST CSF, PCI DSS and HIPAA.
highlights: Traced a holiday intrusion at a large manufacturer to a vulnerable third-party FTP service and blocked it across 12 sites so the team could evict the attackers.
Wrote Python scripts that audit Azure, AWS and GCP against CIS Benchmarks.
Deployed Entra ID, Conditional Access, PIM, Okta, Duo, Defender XDR, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, Sentinel detections, Purview DLP and Intune/Autopilot hardening.

work.name: UST · Client: AvidXchange
highlights: Led enterprise monitoring with Dynatrace, Azure Monitor and Logic Apps automation, cutting recurring service failures by about 95%.
Moved 18 legacy applications to Docker and AKS with Helm and Azure Container Registry.
Built reusable Terraform modules and Azure DevOps pipelines for self-service, SOC-compliant infrastructure.
